headline: Record quarter, margins expand, outlook raised again
summary_short: Loar posted record Q2 2026 net sales of $171.6M (+39.4% y/y, 12.3% organic) with Adjusted EBITDA margin above 40% for a second straight quarter; diluted EPS was $0.18 versus $0.17 a year ago.
summary_long: Net sales grew 39.4% y/y ($171.6M), with 12.3% organic growth plus contributions from the LMB and Harper Engineering acquisitions. Adjusted EBITDA rose 47.4% to $69.4M as margin expanded to 40.5% from 38.3%, which management attributed to execution of strategic value drivers and the accretive effect of higher sales. Net income was flat at $16.7M as revenue growth was offset by higher interest expense and non-cash intangible amortization; diluted EPS was $0.18 (adjusted EPS $0.38, +22.6%). Cash rose to $122.4M and long-term debt roughly tripled y/y to $949.3M after $240M in new debt funded acquisitions. Full-year 2026 guidance was raised across revenue, net income, EBITDA and EPS.
